name: Anthony McRae
desc: Anthony McRae served a 25-year career with the NJ Department of Corrections. He started his career as a Correctional Officer Recruit at East Jersey State Prison in 1991. During his career, he was promoted through the ranks retiring as a Corrections Major. In this capacity, he was responsible for the direction of the custody workforce to ensure that the policy and goals of the Department of Corrections were followed at each institution he was assigned. He finished his career at South Woods State Prison, where he was responsible for over 1000 custody staff, overseeing over 4000 inmates. During his career, he has been recognized for his faithful service and professionalism and his contributions to enhancing operations at the Department of Corrections. Anthony holds a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Fairleigh Dickinson University.
